description_en: Invoke the SaveSingleTaskForAddingDSRecord API to submit a job for creating a DS record
name: SaveSingleTaskForAddingDSRecord

parameters.help_en:
Language of error messages returned by the API. Valid values:
zh: Chinese;
en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文；
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: Key tag used to identify DNSSEC records. It is an integer less than 65536
parameters.help_zh: 密钥标签，用于标识DNSSEC记录，为小于65536的整数值
parameters.name: key_tag

parameters.help_en: User IP address, which can be set to 127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The encryption algorithm number. For more information, see Domain Name System Security (DNSSEC) Algorithm Numbers (https://www.iana.org/assignments/dns-sec-alg-numbers/dns-sec-alg-numbers.xhtml). Valid values:
1: RSA/MD5.
2: Diffie-Hellman.
3: DSA/SHA-1.
5: RSA/SHA-1.
6: DSA-NSEC3-SHA1.
7: RSASHA1-NSEC3-SHA1.
8: RSA/SHA-256.
10: RSA/SHA-512.
12: GOST R 34.10-2001.
13: ECDSA Curve P-256 with SHA-256.
14: ECDSA Curve P-384 with SHA-384.
15: Ed25519 and Ed448.
252: Reserved for Indirect Keys.
253: private algorithm.
254: private algorithm OID
parameters.help_zh:
加密算法编号，详见Domain Name System Security (DNSSEC) Algorithm Numbers (https://www.iana.org/assignments/dns-sec-alg-numbers/dns-sec-alg-numbers.xhtml)。取值：
1：RSA/MD5。
2：Diffie-Hellman。
3：DSA/SHA-1。
5：RSA/SHA-1。
6：DSA-NSEC3-SHA1。
7：RSASHA1-NSEC3-SHA1。
8：RSA/SHA-256。
10：RSA/SHA-512。
12：GOST R 34.10-2001。
13：ECDSA Curve P-256 with SHA-256。
14：ECDSA Curve P-384 with SHA-384。
15：Ed2551916 Ed448。
252：Reserved for Indirect Keys。
253：private algorithm。
254：private algorithm OID
parameters.name: algorithm

parameters.help_zh:
摘要算法类型，详见Delegation Signer (DS) Resource Record (RR) Type Digest Algorithms (https://www.iana.org/assignments/ds-rr-types/ds-rr-types.xhtml)。取值：
1：SHA-1；
2：SHA-256；
3：GOST R 34.11-94；
4：SHA-384
parameters.name: digest_type
